features: TOUCHES THE DATABASE SCHEMA: A NEW COLUMN IN THE BALANCES TABLE, WITH THE FOREIGN KEY ON THE OWNERSHIP TRANSFERS — The update adds to the Wallet balances an optional column that says for which ownership transfer you wrote a row, and links it to the transfers table with a foreign key that does not delete in cascade: a transfer is never deleted, if you cancel it, it stays, cancelled. It moves and rewrites no data: the balances that exist stay without a link, and none is touched. The update applies it by itself, and an interrupted update can be run again. Nothing else in the schema changes.

NEW: THE WALLET BALANCE LINKED TO A TRANSFER — When an ownership transfer leaves a part that the program does not move by itself (the «Cosa cambierà» (what will change) panel states it with the amount and the people, then the unit's history recalls it), the part is passed by hand from the Wallet with two rows of opposite sign: a credit to whoever must have it and a debit of the same amount to whoever must pay it. Before, those rows had to take the place of the brought-forward balance, and whoever already had a brought-forward balance on that management saw the row refused. Now in the «Aggiungi credito» (add credit) dialog (and in the debit one), choosing «Soggetto specifico» (specific person), «Legato a un passaggio» (linked to a transfer) appears, off to start with. Switched on, it asks for the transfer (the menu lists the transfers recorded on the unit, last recorded first, with the people, and writes «c'è una parte da regolare a mano» (there is a part to settle by hand) next to those that have one) and offers all the people of the unit, even those who already have a brought-forward balance; if there are no transfers on the unit a balance can be linked to, the dialog says so. An example: with the end of Ines's lease on 1 July and «Scrivi il conguaglio» (write the settlement), the days after her departure pass to Ugo (€ 181.48); on 1 November Ugo sells to Elsa, and € 60.16 of those days stay with Ugo, as the sale panel says. If they fall to Elsa, write from the Wallet a credit of € 60.16 to Ugo and a debit of € 60.16 to Elsa, linked to the sale of 1 November: the next plan of the management that applies the balances absorbs them, takes those € 60.16 off Ugo and asks them of Elsa. The linked balance does not take the place: the Wallet accepts one balance per person, management, unit and year, not counting those written by a transfer or linked to a transfer, so the linked balance is written next to the brought-forward balance. In the list it has the label «Passaggio» (transfer). For the same transfer, the same person, the same management, the same unit and the same year there is only one, as long as it can still be edited: you correct that one; a linked balance stuck in a plan that is no longer rewritten does not prevent writing one that corrects it. The Wallet does not write a linked balance of € 0.00 («non sposta niente: scrivi l'importo della parte» (it moves nothing: write the amount of the part)), and refuses a linked balance without a person, for a transfer of another condominium or already cancelled, for a transfer that does not concern the unit, for a person who never had a row on the unit, on a management that is not active, and for a transfer recorded before 1.11.0-beta.37, which the program cannot cancel: for it a balance is written without a link. Once written, a linked balance does not change management: you correct the amount, or you delete it and write it again.

CHANGED: CANCELLING A TRANSFER REMOVES THE WALLET BALANCES LINKED TO IT, AND NAMES THOSE WRITTEN BY HAND WITHOUT A LINK — Cancelling a transfer removes, with its ownership rows, the Wallet balances linked to it, even just one: they are rows written by hand, not a pair that must sum to zero. The message before confirming and the one after state them in words («Il saldo del Wallet legato a questo passaggio si toglie: € 60,16 a credito di Ugo (gestione Ordinaria 2026)» (the Wallet balance linked to this transfer is removed: € 60.16 credit to Ugo (management Ordinaria 2026))). If an instalment plan has already absorbed one, the transfer is not cancelled: the refusal is that of the absorbed settlement, with the same ways out. If the plan has not issued anything yet, the refusal says to bring it back to draft, delete it and go back to cancelling the transfer; if the plan can no longer be rewritten, the transfer can stay and the plan is issued as it is, with the linked balances already inside, or the plan must first be reopened, brought back to draft and deleted (the padlock reopens). The balances written by hand from the Wallet after the recording, without linking them to any transfer (the by-hand way of before, or any balance), the cancellation does not remove, because it cannot know whether they were for that transfer: it names them, with a warning per unit that says the person, the amount in words, the management and the plan that has already absorbed them («Dalla registrazione di questo passaggio è stato scritto a mano dal Wallet, su Interno 1, un saldo non legato a nessun passaggio: … Se era per questo passaggio, annullarlo non lo toglie: rivedilo dal Wallet, prima o dopo.» (since this transfer was recorded, a balance not linked to any transfer has been written by hand from the Wallet, on Interno 1: … If it was for this transfer, cancelling it does not remove it: review it from the Wallet, before or after)). It applies to every transfer: before, the warning existed only for some stops, and for the others the cancellation succeeded without saying anything and the row stayed. The balances named are those of a person who has or has had a row on that unit, different from zero, neither written by a transfer nor linked to one; not the debts to suppliers.

CHANGED: THE BY-HAND WAY IS THE WALLET, AND THE SENTENCES STATE THE FACTS OF THE LINKED BALANCES PERSON BY PERSON — The «Cosa cambierà» (what will change) panel of the stops (after «Scrivi il conguaglio» (write the settlement), the end of a tenant, the flatmate who stays) and their history pointed to the Wallet balance only to whoever did not already have a brought-forward balance on that management; for the others they said «la parte si regola fra le parti» (the part is settled between the parties). The transfers already recorded keep in the history the sentence of then. Now, except for the second sale after a stop, the way is the Wallet, with the balances linked to the transfer: «Se vanno a Elsa, registra dal Wallet i saldi legati a questo passaggio, sulla stessa gestione: € 60,16 a credito di Ugo e € 60,16 a debito di Elsa. Un saldo legato non occupa il posto di un riporto, e si toglie se annulli il passaggio.» (if they go to Elsa, record from the Wallet the balances linked to this transfer, on the same management: € 60.16 credit to Ugo and € 60.16 debit to Elsa. A linked balance does not take the place of a brought-forward balance, and is removed if you cancel the transfer). Where a sentence used to work out which row to touch and by how much, it now states the facts and leaves the choice to you: for each person how much their linked balances sum to today and what their part is worth (with the direction, debit or credit), which balances can no longer be edited (in a plan that is no longer rewritten, or in a year that is not the open one, the only one the balances page shows) and where the next step is done. For example: «I saldi del Wallet legati alla vendita del 1 ottobre 2026 sommano oggi € 90,74 a credito di Ugo e € 0,00 per Elsa; la parte che resta è € 30,58 a credito di Ugo e € 30,58 a debito di Elsa. Non si modifica più quello nel piano «Rate di fine anno», che non si riscrive più (€ 90,74 a credito di Ugo). Il programma non li cambia: correggi dal Wallet i saldi che si modificano, e per chi non ne ha uno registra la differenza con un saldo legato alla vendita del 1 ottobre 2026.» (the Wallet balances linked to the sale of 1 October 2026 sum today to € 90.74 credit to Ugo and € 0.00 for Elsa; the part that remains is € 30.58 credit to Ugo and € 30.58 debit to Elsa. The one in the plan «Rate di fine anno», which is no longer rewritten, can no longer be edited (€ 90.74 credit to Ugo). The program does not change them: correct from the Wallet the balances that can be edited, and for whoever has none record the difference with a balance linked to the sale of 1 October 2026). If the balances already sum to the part, the sentence says so and ends there; if the program does not know who a part falls to, it leaves it out and states the next step with a condition («se non sono la parte nuova, …» (if they are not the new part, …)). It applies to the stop that the start of a lease reduces or zeroes, to the part that goes back up with the end of a tenant, to the cancellation of a start or an end of a lease, to «Annulla il conguaglio» (cancel the settlement; it does not remove the balances linked to the transfer and says how much they sum to and what the part of that transfer's stop is worth, zero if it has none) and to the refusal to delete a person. Without an open year the sentence says to open one, because the balances page corrects and records nowhere else.

CHANGED: A PERSON WHO HAS BALANCES LINKED TO A TRANSFER IS NOT DELETED — A person who appears in a recorded transfer could already not be deleted. Now neither is one who has only balances linked to a transfer: the deletion would have removed them silently, and the cancellation of the transfer would no longer have found them. The refusal says «Questa anagrafica non si può eliminare, perché i saldi legati a un passaggio di titolarità (vendita, locazione, usufrutto o successione) la nominano.» (this record cannot be deleted, because the balances linked to an ownership transfer (sale, lease, usufruct or succession) name it) and goes on with the facts: how much the balances sum to, those that are removed from the Wallet if no longer needed, those of another year, which are removed by cancelling the transfer from the unit's history, and those in a plan that is no longer rewritten, which are not removed: the person stays.

CHANGED: THE JOINT-LIABILITY NOTE STATES THE BALANCES LINKED TO THE SALE SEPARATELY — The note that whoever buys is jointly liable with whoever sells (art. 63, para. 4, of the implementing provisions of the Italian Civil Code) states the unpaid amount of the seller net of the settlement pair still in the Wallet, with the instalments and the pair in brackets. The Wallet balances linked to the sale do not enter that figure: the part they move comes from the pair of the end of a lease, a balance outside the seller's instalments, and removing it would say less than what is due. The note states them separately: «Elsa ha inoltre a suo debito € 60,16 con un saldo scritto a mano per lo stesso passaggio.» (Elsa also has € 60.16 to her debit with a balance written by hand for the same transfer) (with several balances «con saldi scritti a mano»; as a credit «a suo credito»). The one of the buyer counts, on the unit of the note, which the plan has not yet absorbed; if the rows sum to zero nothing is said, and a balance already in a plan is no longer stated, like the absorbed pair.

CHANGED: THE GENERATION GATE FOR THE SUCCESSION READS THE BALANCES LINKED TO THE SUCCESSION — When an instalment plan still counts a share of the deceased, the generation gate says so with the amount and with the part that passes to the heirs by share (art. 754 of the Civil Code). The way to pass it is now always the Wallet, with the balances linked to the succession, even for whoever already has a brought-forward balance; before, with a brought-forward balance of someone, the sentence said that the part is settled between the parties. The sentence reads the balances person by person: whoever has balances linked to the succession is compared with those, and a brought-forward balance next to them does not count; whoever has none, with the unlinked balances that the plan absorbs, as before. It asks only for what is missing (the rows of whoever has nothing; in the conditional those of whoever has unlinked balances that the program cannot read), says to correct a linked balance that is not the part, and says whose part is already there. With a plan that does not apply the Wallet balances, the balances linked to the succession are read all the same: whoever already has them is not asked again, and the plan created anew absorbs them. If the part is settled between the parties, the sentence says to remove from the Wallet the balances linked to the succession still free, so that the next plan that applies the balances does not absorb them a second time. If another plan of the same management, not yet issued, has already absorbed them, the sentence does not ask for them again: it says in which plan they are and the two ways out, delete that plan or issue it and record those of this one.

CHANGED: AN EXPENSE ITEM WRITTEN WITH A MINUS COUNTS AS POSITIVE IN EVERY TOTAL, AS THE CALCULATION COUNTS IT — An expense item written as minus € 240.00 (data from the versions up to beta.51: since beta.52 the program no longer accepts it) is charged positive by the share calculation, for € 240.00. Next to «Spese generali» (general expenses) at € 1,200.00 the plan asks for € 1,440.00, but the «Preventivo» (budget) of the chart of accounts added it with the sign and said € 960.00. Now it is counted as positive by the «Preventivo» and the total to be apportioned of the chart of accounts page, the printed breakdown (the row carries the value of the calculation with «(scritta con il meno)» (written with the minus), and a note at the bottom names the item), the list of the charts of accounts, the coverage and the dashboard (the uncovered items name it with the label «Importo negativo» (negative amount)), and the item's row in the chart of accounts. Below the totals of the chart of accounts page a sentence names the item: «La voce «Rimborso» ha un importo negativo (meno € 240,00): il calcolo delle quote la addebiterebbe in positivo, per € 240,00, e il preventivo la conta così. Se è un provento, scegli «Entrata» e scrivi l'importo senza il segno.» (the item «Rimborso» has a negative amount (minus € 240.00): the share calculation would charge it as positive, for € 240.00, and the budget counts it so. If it is revenue, choose «Entrata» and write the amount without the sign). If the item is already in a plan, the sentence names the plan, with the link to its page, and points to the notice on that page instead of proposing a correction that would be refused there; if an approved plan holds the item, or a chapter above it, without charging it, the sentence names that plan and gives the way that works: bring it back to draft before correcting the amount.

CHANGED: A NEW PLAN DOES NOT TAKE AN EXPENSE ITEM WRITTEN WITH A MINUS, AND «SPOSTA SPESA» DOES NOT MOVE IT — When creating an instalment plan, the item selector proposed an item written with a minus as «Esaurito» (exhausted), or as «Sforo da recuperare» (overrun to recover) if an earlier plan already charged it: the second plan charged it again (€ 480.00 in all for an item written as minus € 240.00), without a warning. Now the item is disabled, with the label «Importo negativo» and a note that says the way; if the request carries it all the same with an amount, the server refuses it on the row's field, naming the item and the plans that charge it: «La voce di spesa «Rimborso» ha un importo negativo (meno € 240,00) ed è già nel piano «Preventivo 2026», che la addebita in positivo: un piano nuovo la addebiterebbe una seconda volta.» (the expense item «Rimborso» has a negative amount (minus € 240.00) and is already in the plan «Preventivo 2026», which charges it as positive: a new plan would charge it a second time). A row without an amount is stopped by the plan's stop; a row at zero is not refused, and the plan is born with the copy at zero, which does not charge the item. «Sposta spesa» (move expense) neither takes budget from nor gives budget to an item that the plan counts with a negative amount (the notice at the top of the page names it), nor to the chapter that apportions it, nor to an expense item written with a minus that the plan does not count so, nor to a chapter outside the plan with a negative sub-account: the plan would charge it as positive, or more. The menus do not offer those items, and the dialog says so under the menu that lost them; the reversal of a move already written remains possible.

CHANGED: AN APPROVED PLAN ALSO BLOCKS THE PARENT, THE TYPE, THE TABLE AND THE PERCENTAGES OF AN ITEM — The «Modifica inibita» (edit blocked) block looked only at the amount. But changing the parent of an item, its type (expense or income), its table or its percentages changes all the same what an approved plan charges, and to whom: the approved plan's apportionment by person changed with nobody stopping it. Now the amount, the parent, the type, the table and the percentages of an item cannot be changed while an approved, issued or closed plan holds it, with its own row or with that of a chapter above it, at any level. The item is not deleted, the chart of accounts that contains it is not deleted, a chapter does not go back to being an item, and under a held chapter no item is added or moved. The refusal appears under the changed field and says the way: «Modifica inibita: l'importo, il padre, il tipo, la tabella e le percentuali della voce non si cambiano finché la voce è nel piano «Preventivo 2026», approvato: riporta prima il piano in bozza dalla sua pagina, poi modifica la voce. Riportandolo in bozza si azzerano il numero del verbale e la nota dell'approvazione: annotali prima; con delle rate emesse, prima vanno annullate le emissioni.» (edit blocked: the amount, the parent, the type, the table and the percentages of the item cannot be changed while the item is in the plan «Preventivo 2026», approved: first bring the plan back to draft from its page, then edit the item. Bringing it back to draft clears the minutes number and the approval note: write them down first; with instalments issued, the issues must be cancelled first). With instalments issued the sentence says what to cancel first: the recorded payments and the credits used or refunded, and the ownership transfers recorded after the issue, to be recorded again afterwards. If a transfer recorded before 1.11.0-beta.37, which the program cannot cancel, stops the cancellation of the issues, the sentence says that the item stays as it is. The block also applies to an approved extraordinary plan, on the items where it has a recorded out-of-budget expense or the cover of a past expense; it does not apply to the other rows of its invoices. The item's form and the tables panel do not let you write what saving would refuse: in the form the type, the «capitolo» (chapter) and «sottoconto» (sub-account) switches, the parent chapter, the table, the percentages and the amount stay disabled, with the server's sentence at the top; the parent chapter menu shows greyed out the chapters that an approved plan holds, with the plan next to them, and does not let you pick them; in the tables panel «Ripartizione bloccata.» (apportionment blocked) appears, and «Aggiungi» (add) and the row buttons are disabled («Piano approvato — bloccato» (plan approved — blocked)). The usufruct transfer does not move to the «Usufruttuario» (usufructuary) the items held in this way by an approved extraordinary plan: it lists them as blocked, as it already did for those of an ordinary plan.

CHANGED: «AD» BEFORE NAMES THAT START WITH «A», IN ALL THE SENTENCES OF THE TRANSFERS — Up to beta.52 the succession and the sentences of the stops wrote «ad Anna» (the Italian preposition before a name starting with A); the other sentences of the transfers (the sale, the start and end of a lease, the usufruct, the settlement, the cancellation, the history and the joint-liability note) wrote «a Anna». Now in all the sentences of the transfers a person called Anna, Alessandro or Aldo is «ad Anna», and where the sentence names a person with the article («il nudo proprietario» (the bare owner), «l'erede di riferimento» (the reference heir)) the preposition is combined: «al nudo proprietario», «all'erede di riferimento». It also applies to the issue sentences that name who took the shares and to the table of the units under usufruct in the transfer form. A surname like «Lo Presti» or «La Rosa» is a name, and stays «a Lo Presti».

FIX OF BETA.52: THE «AGGIUNGI CREDITO» DIALOG NO LONGER HIDES A SENTENCE AND NO LONGER CUTS THE MENU OF PEOPLE — In the «Aggiungi credito» dialog (and in the debit one) the sentence «Questa gestione ha già un saldo per l'intero immobile: modifica quello esistente.» (this management already has a balance for the whole property: edit the existing one) sat inside the first choice, and the people field covered it (on a wide screen) or the second choice (on a narrow screen); the «Soggetto specifico» menu with four people came out of the bottom of the dialog, cut the last person and covered «Annulla» and «Salva Credito». Now the sentence has its own row under the two choices, the menu opens above the rest of the page and the body of the dialog scrolls within the screen, with the header and the footer fixed: on a narrow screen «Salva Credito» stays visible.

FIX: THE ROW OF AN ITEM IN THE CHART OF ACCOUNTS NO LONGER SHOWS A «PIANO RATE STRAORDINARIO» (EXTRAORDINARY INSTALMENT PLAN) THAT DOES NOT EXIST — With an item in two plans, a copy written in one and a null copy («lascia vuoto» (leave empty)) in the other, the item's row in the chart of accounts listed the real plan and a «Piano rate straordinario» (extraordinary instalment plan) («Copertura generata dal piano rate straordinario.») for the same amount; the same with a positive item. The null copy was worth «the rest of the requirement» after the written copies, while the calculation and the coverage read it as the item's amount. Now it is worth the item's amount, in absolute value, and the rows sum to the committed amount. Closed with the same cause are also a chapter with a null copy (which showed three ghost rows), a sub-account with a null copy of its own and the chapter in another plan, and a null copy with an item spent beyond the budget. It had been there since v1.9.0.

FIX: THE SENTENCES OF THE STOPS AFTER A STOP — When whoever sells had bought their part from different people (Elsa buys the part of Anna and that of Ugo and resells everything to Carlo), the part of the stop was worked out from the last stop only: it all went to Ugo's charge, and following the sentence from the Wallet half of Anna's ended up with Ugo. Now the part of whoever leaves is read from the chain of their row: the transfer that opened it or added a share to it, and backwards those of the rows that it closed to open it. The stops of those transfers count, not those of a part already resold nor of another row of the same person; with several stops the part is at the charge of the people of those stops together, with the alternative «o di Elsa se la parte di Elsa è già stata regolata» (or Elsa's if Elsa's part has already been settled). With several people at charge together the sentence names them all, with the amount of the group; the stop of the end of a tenant carries the names of all the people at charge, so that the sentence does not zero the second one's row. The reasons that ask for the tick, the history of the reduced stop and that of the part that goes back up said «fra Ugo e Carlo» (between Ugo and Carlo) as a fact: now they say «fra chi ne risponde (Ugo, o Elsa se la fermata della vendita del … è già stata regolata) e Carlo» (between whoever answers for it (Ugo, or Elsa if the stop of the sale of … has already been settled) and Carlo). Some of these sentences had been there since beta.50.

FIX: THE USUFRUCT TRANSFER DOES NOT MOVE THE ITEMS OF AN APPROVED EXTRAORDINARY PLAN — For the extraordinary plans the usufruct transfer read a rule of its own, which looked at the invoice rows only and not at the covers of past expenses: the item of a past expense held by an approved extraordinary plan was moved to the «Usufruttuario», and the recalculation would have given the usufructuary an extraordinary expense (art. 1005 of the Civil Code: it goes to the bare owner). Now the rule is one, that of the item's page: the out-of-budget expense rows and the covers of a past expense count, not the ordinary row of a mixed invoice, which the extraordinary plan does not apportion on the item.

FIX: THE CONFIRMATION OF «RIMUOVI VOCE» ON INCOME ITEMS — In the instalment plan the confirmation said, even for an income item, «Stai per eliminare la voce di spesa:» (you are about to delete the expense item) and «Il totale del piano diminuirà dell'importo indicato» (the plan total will decrease by the amount shown), while the same page marks the income with its badge and shows it with the minus. Now for an income it says «Stai per eliminare la voce di entrata:» and «Il totale da ripartire aumenterà dell'importo indicato» (the total to apportion will increase by the amount shown); the amount of a copy written with a minus (data from before beta.52) is shown without the sign, and for a group the sentence says «dell'importo del gruppo» (by the amount of the group), because the confirmation shows no amount next to the name. It had been there since v1.9.0.

FIX: DELETING AN ITEM OR A CHART OF ACCOUNTS WITH INVOICE ROWS — An item with invoice rows is not deleted, and bringing a plan back to draft does not remove them. Before, the refusal was the plans' one («Impossibile eliminare: la voce è associata a un piano rate approvato, emesso o chiuso.» (cannot delete: the item is associated with an approved, issued or closed instalment plan)), which made one believe that the draft was enough; then the deletion stopped at the database and the error message appeared on screen. Now the refusal for the invoice rows comes first and says why («Eliminazione inibita: la voce ha 2 righe di fattura registrate, e una voce con delle righe di fattura non si elimina: la voce resta.» (deletion blocked: the item has 2 recorded invoice rows, and an item with invoice rows is not deleted: the item stays); for the chart of accounts, how many items have them), and a real database error goes into the application log while the page says «Si è verificato un errore durante l'eliminazione della voce di spesa.» (an error occurred while deleting the expense item).

OTHER FIXES — Saving the form of a chapter that stays a chapter no longer zeroes its amount (data from the versions up to 1.9.1, which changed what the calculation charges); an item that becomes a chapter takes its amount to zero, as before. The Rata Zero provision, when recording a past invoice, and the event that signals the Rata Zero gap do not count the balances linked to a transfer: they move money between two people and bring none in. The refund box in the person's statement of account counts the credit of a balance linked to a transfer, not yet absorbed, like that of the pair of a settlement (not that of the deceased linked to their succession with the arrears to the heirs, which offsets the share that the plan still works out for them). The immediate adjustment guide says «Il capitolo non mostra il residuo, a differenza della fattura: la spesa alza il consuntivo della voce.» (the chapter does not show the remainder, unlike the invoice: the expense raises the item's actual) in place of «Il capitolo mostra il suo residuo» (the chapter shows its remainder), which the chapter menu never showed. The history of a usufruct transfer says «Dal … all'usufruttuario, secondo la regola di legge (art. 1004 c.c.): …» (from … to the usufructuary, according to the rule of law (art. 1004 of the Civil Code)) (without the article where only income passes) in place of «la proposta di legge», which in Italian is a bill. The guides and the command that looks for items outside the structure no longer suggest deleting an item at the third level: it is moved under a first-level chapter.

THE GUIDES — The opening balances guide has a new section, «Il saldo legato a un passaggio» (the balance linked to a transfer): what it is for, the example of Ugo and Elsa with the amounts, one row per person on the same management and the same unit, the place of the brought-forward balance, the cancellation and what happens when the part changes; the long point on the part that the program does not move, which was in the pair section, has become a pointer. The ownership transfer guide, the instalment plan guide (the succession) and the texts that the Wallet shows next to the rows of a transfer state the by-hand way with the linked balances and the Wallet rule with its two exceptions. The instalment plan detail guide says that an expense item with a negative amount neither gives nor receives budget in «Sposta spesa». The chart of accounts operations guide says what an approved plan blocks of an item, and what to do.

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE — (1) Cancelling a transfer removes the balances linked to it and names, without touching them, those written by hand without a link: the program cannot know whether any balance was for that transfer. (2) The Wallet shows and corrects only the open year: a linked balance in another year is neither seen nor edited from there; the transfer's sentence says so, and it is removed by cancelling the transfer from the unit's history. (3) After a stop already settled with linked balances, the second sale does not read those balances: the panel says that the part is settled between the parties and that the program does not know how the earlier stop was settled. (4) A transfer recorded before 1.11.0-beta.37 cannot be cancelled by the program, and so is not linked to a balance. (5) The joint-liability note states the linked balances separately and does not take them off the unpaid figure: where a linked balance moves a part of the seller's instalments already issued, that part appears twice, in excess. (6) An item that two plans of the same management charge, one with a written copy and one with the empty copy, is charged by both plans: the item's row in the chart of accounts shows it (coverage at 200 %), and no plan page signals it.
